primary_source_scope.author_source: K. S. Kedlaya's own 18.785 course landing and calendar directly host/link the formula and proof course units.
primary_source_scope.course_identity: Both frozen PDFs identify themselves as '18.785: Analytic Number Theory, MIT, spring 2007 (K.S. Kedlaya)'.
primary_source_scope.official_independent_metadata: Pinned DSpace API item metadata for handle 1721.1/101679 names the same course and Kedlaya as author and marks the item a non-withdrawn publication.
primary_source_scope.preregistration_effect: The Cycle-2 requirement is one reachable primary source. It does not require proving byte identity between an author-hosted primary copy and a repository mirror.

distribution_caveat.statement: Direct DSpace bitstream retrieval was unavailable in this run, and byte identity between the frozen author-hosted PDFs and any DSpace bitstream was not established. This is a distribution/provenance caveat outside the preregistered mathematical source-authority requirement.
distribution_caveat.non_claim: This record does not assert that author-hosted bytes inherit the OCW/DSpace CC license.

frozen_primary_units.checked: For every x>=2,T>0, half-weighted psi formula with |Im rho|<T and the distance-to-other-prime-power remainder.
Every zero residue is counted with multiplicity; the proof completes.

transfer.endpoint: u=ceil(x)-1, v=floor(x+y); half-weight transfer and v-u=y+O(1) cost O(log x).
transfer.remainder: At integral u,v, the distance to every other prime power is at least one. For 2<=T<=x the endpoint formula errors are O(x(log x)^3/T).
transfer.height_convention: The |gamma|<T to literal |rho|<=T mismatch is in unit boundary strips and costs O(x log T/T) by the multiplicity-inclusive HSW+Bui count.

renderer.role: Extract pinned PDF text for replayed anchors.
